name: Service tile grid
description: One tile per service, status badge derived from a metric split by service.name (e.g. 'service.up' with value 0|1). Bind any numeric metric whose split-by produces one row per service.

spec.template:
{{#each services as s}}
{{ s.key }}
{{ format s.value 'none' 1 }}
{{/each}}
spec.styles: .svc { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(170px, 1fr)); gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem; align-content: start; } .tile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 6%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 14%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-md); min-width: 0; } .tile .dot { width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-graphite-500); flex: 0 0 auto; } .tile.vellum-th-ok .dot   { background: var(--color-sage-500); } .tile.vellum-th-warn .dot { background: var(--color-amber-500); } .tile.vellum-th-bad .dot  { background: var(--color-rust-500); } .tile .body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.05rem; } .tile .name { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .tile .value { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--color-graphite-500); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

dataBindings.name: services
dataBindings.description: metric split by service.name; e.g. service.up with 0/1 value
